5845probands(5307WES+538TES);63rareheterozygousvariants,23coding,8proposedpathogenicvariants9families17individuals. No direct functional assay of any of these eight alleles. Prior FZD5 secreted WNT-binding frameshift mechanism does not demonstrate equivalence of these late frameshifts or missense alleles.

Authors use PS4 for all8variants without a displayed statistical enrichment test/control comparison. PP4 specificity weak across genetically heterogeneouscoloboma andcommonmyopia. PVS1/assumedLOF not automatically established by prior secreted dominant-interfering protein. PP2 asserted for first disease-associatedmissense series. Table possiblypathogenic versus discussionlikelypathogenic terminology is not independent ACMG adjudication.

Method excludes variants in patients with pathogenic variants in other genes as benign; alternate molecular diagnosis does not prove FZD5benign or exclude multilocus contribution. Noncoding/splice-prediction-negative filtering is not functional exoneration. Supplemental15likelybenignvariants include some damaging predictors; none independently functionally established benign.

Internal figure-label errors: Figure2D printed5485II1 butcaptionlists5485I1; Figure3H actual12467II1 butcaption1267II1. Do not transfer coloboma to unrelated1267. Family940 Table2I1 differspedigreeII1. Table1 allhg19positions rounded2.1E08, preventingexactgenomicmapping. MainNM003468.3 vs packets.4 samec./p., independent equivalence/hg38indelnormalization unperformed.

Highhypermetropia negative in18739II1 contradicted by+6.75/+7.00. Positivehighhypermetropia in5485I1/18739I1 not established: rows contain axial lengths inparentheses, not positive refraction. 18739II1 age4.8decimalyears doesnotexactlyequalpacket4y8m. Table2 initialsymptom field is not an exhaustive negative review of systems. NA nevernegative. CCfundus doesnotexcludeotherretinal/opticdisc/fovealabnormalities.

All main and linked appendix content consumed; no external WESrawdata or prior mechanisticpapers read/reanalyzed here. Eye-levelcounts12coloboma/12variant/10myopia overlap and should not be summed as mutuallyexclusive individual phenotypes.
